settings.widget_id_help: Paste the snippet from your Asyntai dashboard, or only the widget ID. Leave this field empty to switch the chat off. You find the ID at asyntai.com under Setup & Integration.
settings.hide_for_members_help: Members who are logged in never see the chat.
settings.script_url_help: Leave this field empty to use the standard address https://widget.asyntai.com/static/js/chat-widget.js
